title: St. James Infirmary
attribution: Traditional American blues descended from the British "Unfortunate Rake"; the words are version B of "Those Gambler's Blues" as printed in Carl Sandburg's The American Songbag (1927), where the hospital is still "St. Joe's" (the later "St. James" wording comes from the 1929 Mills sheet music and is left out). Sandburg, who collected and printed it, died in 1967. Public domain: traditional, published before 1931 (United States), and neither the song nor Sandburg's printing has an author who died after 1971 (Canada).
